diagnosis: The cached native ILP graph is valid after geometry filtering but intrinsically extremely sparse: only 2-26 candidate edges per forward movie and 6-124 per reverse movie, versus 4,752-65,161 and 14,899-60,580 registered edges. This follows from the inherited softmax >0.5 candidate threshold; node IDs were verified against predict_video/build_graph and are not the cause.
correction: An early ID-mismatch suspicion was disproved by source inspection and edge-count telemetry. The authoritative diagnosis is sparse learned topology, not incompatible IDs.
metric_self_local_recompute: Same metrics and decision; path and float-reduction differences change JSON bytes only.
decision: Reject. Native edges may only be tested as sparse evidence added to the registered parent, never as a replacement topology.
